read.en: Sandisk fell 8.5% on Oct 22 to $1,260.93, trading between $1,244.60 and $1,355.00 on 1.3 times average volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($1,335.0), 10-day ($1,402.5), 30-day ($1,600.9) and 100-day ($1,631.2) averages, and above the rising 200-day ($1,231.9). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2 and is below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 6 ($1,484.47), and RSI is 31.

After holding three sessions, the $1,325 Jul 17 low gave way, along with the $1,276 Oct 15 low; both now act as resistance. Resistance is $1,276–1,277, then $1,325–1,335 (5-day) and $1,401–1,402 (10-day). Support is $1,244.6 (Oct 22 low), then $1,232 (200-day) and $998 (Jul 29 low). A close above $1,277 would target $1,325–1,335; a close below the 200-day would open the $1,000 area.
